def get_rects(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols={x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg}
    out=[]
    for c in cols:
        pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs=sorted(p[0] for p in pts); cs=sorted(p[1] for p in pts)
        R,C=min(rs),min(cs); H=max(rs)-R+1; W=max(cs)-C+1
        mask=[[g[R+i][C+j]==c and 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
        # bounding box of the pattern itself (shape is a rectangle outline, find min box containing all cells)
        rows_with=[i for i in range(H) if any(mask[i])]; cols_with=[j for j in range(W) if any(mask[:,j])]
        sr,sc=min(rows_with),min(cols_with); sh=H-max(rows_with)+1; sw=W-max(cols_with)+1
        bbox=(sr,sc,sh,sw)
        out.append((bbox,c,H,W))
    return sorted(out,key=lambda t:t[2])
for k,g in [('di',di),('do',do_)]:
    print(k,get_rects(g))

def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg]
    rows=sorted({p[0] for p in pts}); cols=sorted({p[1] for p in pts})
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # group rows into connected run-length bands per color
    cur=[]
    for i in range(h):
        c=g[i][0]
        if c!=bg:
            pass
    # find shapes by color
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    colsets={}
    for c in {x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg}:
        colsets[c]=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j]==c for i in range(h))]
    for i in range(h):
        for j,x in enumerate(g[i]):
            if x==bg: continue
            rs=[r for r,c2 in [(r,i) for r in range(h)] if False]
            break
    # per-color bbox
    for c in colsets:
        rs=[i for i in range(h) for j in colsets[c] if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=sorted(rs)
        top,bottom=rs[0],rs[-1]
        cs=colsets[c]; left=min(cs); right=max(cs)
        for i in range(top+1,bottom+1):
            for j,x in enumerate(g[i]):
                if x==c: out[i][j+1]=c
        # keep bottom row
        for j,x in enumerate(g[bottom]):
            if x==c: out[bottom][j]=c
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bgc]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j,x in enumerate(g[i]):
            if x==bgc: continue
            move = (i+1 < h) and g[i+1][j]==bgc
            nj=j+1 if move else j
            if nj<w: out[i][nj]=x
    return out

from collections import Counter
G=None
import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# For each colored cell, check: stay iff below is same color OR no cell below; move otherwise.
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bgc]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j,x in enumerate(g[i]):
            if x==bgc: continue
            stay = (i+1>=h) or g[i+1][j]==x
            nj=j if stay else j+1
            if nj<w: out[i][nj]=x
    return out

import json
from collections import Counter
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # 4-connectivity components of same-color non-bg cells
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==cnt or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp={(i,j)}; seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==c:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; comp.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
            bot=max(p[0] for p in comp)
            kept={ (p[0],p[1]) for p in comp if p[0]==bot } | set(comp)
            # decide which move/stay: cell stays iff on bottom row OR has same color directly below (which is only possible if below row also same color... check) 
            for (a,b) in sorted(comp,key=lambda p:(p[1],p[0])):
                if a==bot: continue
                down=(a+1,b)
                # allowed to stay if the cell below belongs to this component with same color
                if down in comp: continue
                if b+1<w: out[a][b+1]=g[a][b]
                else: out[a][b]=g[a][b]
    return out

    o=f(G[k+' input']); e=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'mismatch',sum(o[i][j]!=e[i][j] for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0]))))
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import json
from collections import Counter
G=load()
def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==cnt or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cs={(i,j)}; seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==c:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; cs.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
            r0=min(p[0] for p in cs); r1=max(p[0] for p in cs)
            res.append((c,cs,r0,r1))
    return res
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c,cs,r0,r1 in comps(g):
        bot=r1
        for (a,b) in sorted(cs,key=lambda p:(p[1],p[0])):
            # stays if on bottom row or has same-colored cell directly below
            if a==bot or (a+1<bh:=False): pass
            if a==bot or (a+1 < len(g) and g[a+1][b]==c): out[a][b]=c
            elif b+1 < w: out[a][b+1]=c
            else: out[a][b]=c
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    mis=[(i,j,f(G[k+' input'])[i][j],G[k+' output'][i][j]) for i in range(len(G[k+' input'])) for j in range(len(G[k+' input'][0])) if f(G[k+' input'])[i][j]!=G[k+' output'][i][j]]
    print(k,'mismatches',len(mis))
    for m in mis[:8]: print(m)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import json
from collections import Counter
G=load()
def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==cnt or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cs={(i,j)}; seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==c:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; cs.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
            r0=min(p[0] for p in cs); r1=max(p[0] for p in cs)
            res.append((c,cs,r0,r1))

import json
from collections import Counter
G=load()
def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cs={(i,j)}; seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==c:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; cs.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
            r0=min(p[0] for p in cs); r1=max(p[0] for p in cs)
            res.append((c,cs,r0,r1))
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    a=G[k+' input']; b=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    print('===',k,h,'x',w)
    for ci,(c,cs,r0,r1) in enumerate(comps(a)):
        cols=sorted(set(j for i,j in cs))
        placed=set(); moved=set()
        for (i,j) in sorted(cs,key=lambda p:(p[1],p[0])):
            if b[i][j]==c and b[i][j]!=a[i][j]: placed.add((i,j))
            else: moved.add((i,j))
        # which stayed exactly in place?
        ip=[(i,j) for (i,j) in cs if b[i][j]==a[i][j]]
        # new positions of cells that were not in-place
        np_=[(i,j) for (i,j) in cs if b[i][j]==c and b[i][j]!=a[i][j]]
        print(f'comp{ci} color{c} rows{r0}-{r1} cols{min(cols)}-{max(cols)} n={len(cs)}')
        print('   stay-in-place:',sorted(ip))
        print('   moved-from:',sorted(moved))
        print('   move-to:',sorted(np_))

def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cs={(i,j)}; seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==c:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; cs.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
            rs={p[0] for p in cs}; cl={p[1] for p in cs}
            res.append((c,min(rs),max(rs),min(cl),max(cl)))
    return res

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

        for i,j in sc: newcells[(i,j+1)]=c

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

# displacement of each non-bg cell per pair: match each input cell to nearest output cell of same color
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    a=G[k+' input']; b=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    from collections import Counter
    ca=Counter(v for r in a for v in r); cb=Counter(v for r in b for v in r)
    bgv=ca.most_common(1)[0][0]
    inp={}; outp={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if a[i][j]!=bgv: inp[(i,j)]=a[i][j]
            if b[i][j]!=bgv: outp[(i,j)]=b[i][j]
    moves=[]
    for (i,j),c in inp.items():
        cands=[(u,v) for (u,v),cc in outp.items() if cc==c]
        dmin=min(abs(u-i)+abs(v-j) for u,v in cands)
        matches=[(u,v) for u,v in cands if abs(u-i)+abs(v-j)==dmin]
        if len(matches)==1:
            u,v=matches[0]; moves.append(((i,j),(u,v),dmin))
    print(k,'matched',len([m for m in moves if m[2]==1]),'/',len(inp))
    # classify per pair: what displacements occurred
    from collections import defaultdict
    dd=defaultdict(int)
    for s,(u,v),dm in moves:
        if dm==1: dd[(u-s[0],v-s[1])]+=1
    print(' displ:',dd)

# Fix f: implement "each object shifts right as far as possible (until collision/edge), one step at a time; objects move independently in parallel" 
from collections import Counter, deque

def objects(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); comp=set(); seen[r][c]=True
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==col and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps

def shift_ok(comp,g,h,w,s):
    # s>=0 target column = original c + s? use relative to object's min col within grid
    rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
    mc,minc=min(cs)
    new={(r,c+s-minc) for r,c in comp}
    # bounds: new cols must be in [0,w)
    if any(c+w-1>s or c<s+mc-w... ) : pass
    if any(not(0<=c<w) for r,c in new): return False
    return True

def f_all(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=objects(gi,bg)
    # per object max shift without hitting other objects or edge
    results=[]
    for comp in comps:
        cols=sorted({c for r,c in comp})
        mc=cols[0]
        cells=(r-c) for r,c in comp
        mx=0
        for s in range(1,w-mc):
            if any(0<=nc<w and gi[r][nc]==bg for r,c in comp for nc in []) or True:
                # check target overlap with other objects' footprint
                ok=True
                for r,c in comp:
                    nc=c+s
                    if nc>=w: ok=False;break
                    if gi[r][nc]!=bg: ok=False;break
                if ok: mx=s
        mx=min(mx,w-1-cols[-1]+1)
        results.append((comp,mx))
    # apply all simultaneously
    newg=[row[:] for row in gi]; occ=set()
    for comp,mx in results:
        mc=min(c for r,c in comp)
        for r,c in comp:
            nc=c+mx
            if nc>w: continue
            if gi[r][nc]!=bg: continue
            newg[r][nc]=gi[r][c]
    return newg

for n in range(1,7):

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter as Ct, deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# For each demo, match each input non-bg cell to nearest output cell of same color, report displacement histogram
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=Ct(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    inp=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=bg]
    hist=Ct(); unmoved=[]
    for r,c,v in inp:
        # nearest output cell of same color
        cands=sorted(((abs(y-r)+abs(x-c),y,x,y-r,x-c) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if go[y][x]==v))
        d_,yy,xx,dy,dx=cands[0]
        hist[(dy,dx)]+=1
        if (dy,dx)!=(0,1) and (dy,dx)!=(0,-1) and (dy,dx)!=(0,0): pass
    print('pair',n,'size',len(inp))
    print(dict(hist))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Per-cell features: for each colored cell, features and whether it moves right by one (same color) in output
rowsdata=[]
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if gi[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                col=gi[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; cells=set()
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.add((a,b))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and gi[na][nb]==col:
                            seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
                comps.append((col,cells))
    for col,cells in comps:
        rs=sorted(a for a,_ in cells); cs=sorted(b for _,b in cells)
        for a,b in cells:
            ab=go[a][b]==col   # stayed
            f={}
            # neighbors in input
            f['left']=(a,b-1) in cells
            f['right']=(a,b+1) in cells
            f['below']=0<(a+1)<h and (a+1,b) in cells
            f['above']=0<(a-1) and (a-1,b) in cells
            f['diag_bl']=0<(a+1) and 0<(b-1) and (a+1,b-1) in cells
            f['diag_br']=0<(a+1) and 0<(b+1) and (a+1,b+1) in cells
            f['minrow']=a==rs[0]
            f['maxrow']=a==rs[-1]
            f['mincol']=b==cs[0]
            f['maxcol']=b==cs[-1]
            f['size']=len(cells)
            rowsdata.append((ab,f,n,a,b,col,len(gi),len(gi[0])))
print(sorted(rowsdata,key=lambda x:(not x[0],x[2])), '\n--- count by size ---')
by_s=Counter()
for r in rowsdata: by_s[r[6]]+=1
print(by_s)
cnt=sum(1 for r in rowsdata if r[0])
print('kept:',cnt,'total:',len(rowsdata))
